primary.title: ₹90 dividend per share: This stock announces 900% payout - Do you own? Payment, record date, returns
primary.summary: Bayer CropScience declared an interim dividend of ₹90 per share for FY27, with November 12 set as the record date and payment due by November 30, 2026. Second-quarter net profit rose to ₹166.2 crore from ₹152.7 crore a year earlier.
